capabilities: Fetch Quran ayat by Surah and range from selectable providers
Fetch hadith by book and reference number from selectable providers
Preview and edit fetched text before inserting or copying
Configure providers, translations, link destinations, and output formatting
Download and manage offline databases and normalize Arabic honorifics
extras: README warns users to verify fetched Ahadith and provider links, lists known bugs and a roadmap, documents which network requests are sent to providers, and recommends specific providers. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up and insert Quranic verses or hadith with chosen translations, source links, and honorific formatting, so users must copy and format such texts manually.

relations.evidence: Arabic Quran text and translations discovered from its edition catalog.
Collections and translations from its edition catalog, with Arabic and translation editions retrieved separately.
17 books from the pinned hadith-json v1.2.0 dataset, with Arabic and English text.
Uses Sunnah.com data (e.g., using 204a for Sahih Muslim)

requires.name: online Quran and Hadith providers (e.g., Al Quran Cloud, hadith-api)

summary: Fetches Quran verses and hadith from online providers and inserts them into notes with translations, links, formatting, and offline database support.
